result:
O1-1 is finished and committed (`dda85fd`), and I recorded it in the tracker (`aea5c3d`). The 12 new tests in `tests/test_os_assist_locate.py` pass, all with fake elements. I did not run the full suite or the existing test files, and nothing was tried against a real browser.

- **Worker:** `core/os_assist/worker.py` runs one daemon thread named `os-assist-uia` with its own UIA object. It has `submit(fn, *args)`, which returns a Future, and `stop()`. It does not use the shared worker in `vsdc_uia_text`.
- **Locate:** `core/os_assist/locate.py` has all the functions the WP listed, ported from the spike without importing it. `page_rect` returns `(left, top, right, bottom)` or `None`.
- **Calling it:** the locate functions take no UIA argument, so they have to be called inside `worker.submit(...)`. Tests install a fake with `worker.bind(fake)`.
- **Selectors:** a `#id` selector that matches no visible box falls back to the normal "first password box, nearest text box before it" rule.
- **Read-only:** nothing in these files calls a pattern method.

I added the hand-off note under §9 of the blueprint. It tells O1-2 to re-check the host with `host_matches_service` right before each write.

The first commit also swept in `.os-assist.lock`, `logs/os-assist/*.json` and `docs/os_assist/os-assist-report.md`, because the `git add -A` the WP prescribes picked up the dispatcher's own files.
